button.title: Button
button.description: Accessible button with 9 variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, error, success, warning, info, text, icon) and 3 sizes. Built on Base UI with BCT design tokens.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Semantic horizontal or vertical separator built on Base UI. Sets role=separator and aria-orientation automatically.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Avatar with image, initials fallback, and icon fallback. Built on Base UI Avatar primitives with size and shape props.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Progress bar with determinate and indeterminate states. Built on Base UI with BCT design tokens.

meter.title: Meter
meter.description: Meter bar for displaying a scalar value within a defined range. Renders a visible label. Built on Base UI with BCT design tokens.

field.title: Field
field.description: Form field container with label, helper text, error text, and required marker. Wraps Base UI Field primitives for automatic aria association.

fieldset.title: Fieldset
fieldset.description: Semantic fieldset container with a legend prop. Renders a native <fieldset> with a proper <legend> element for accessible group labeling.

form.title: Form
form.description: Thin form wrapper with onSubmit passthrough. Composes Field + Input inside as children. Built on Base UI Form.

input.title: Input
input.description: Text input with inline label, helper text, error text, icon (left or right), and size variants (sm/md/lg). Ref forwards to the native <input> for react-hook-form compatibility.

switch.title: Switch
switch.description: Toggle switch with animated thumb. Accepts checked/defaultChecked and onCheckedChange. Renders a label alongside the track.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: Pressable toggle button with three variants (default, outline, ghost) and three sizes (sm/md/lg). Uses data-pressed for pressed-state styling.

text-area.title: TextArea
text-area.description: Multiline text input with inline label, helper text, error text, optional char count display, and rows/maxLength props. Ref forwards to the native <textarea>.
